summary.title: Accept-shape: VanVleet for Mobley + Edgecombe + Nurkić (Jesse)
summary.headline: Give Fred VanVleet; get Evan Mobley, VJ Edgecombe, Jusuf Nurkić (Out); then drop Nurkić and Jeremiah Fears.
summary.verdict: Strong yes: helps under all three projection sets, also schedule-neutral. Partner loses a lot, so confirm before he rethinks.
rationale: - Mobley (big: rebounds, blocks, FG%) + Edgecombe (young guard) for one 32-year-old guard.
- Schedule-neutral still +1.8 ± 0.5 pp title, +2.4 pp playoffs: part of the gain is playoff-week games.
- Roster fits: Nurkić (Out) is dropped, Fears is the weakest remaining player.

why_now.before: Yesterday we offered VanVleet for Edgecombe + Nurkić (+2.5 to +3.9 pp title); the partner said Edgecombe wasn't available alone.

changed.text: The partner proposed this bigger shape himself (details private).
Evaluated today with inseason-0.3.0: helps in all 3 projection sets.

risks: A 'pick' was mentioned; Yahoo can't trade draft picks in-season, so offer players only.
Drops Fears and Nurkić; both go to waivers.
Partner's odds fall ~10 pp, so he may withdraw; 2-day commissioner review.
